description: Live gas snapshot across EVM chains in one call (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or chain= for one): latest block, block age, base fee, gas price and priority fee in gwei, plus the estimated cost of a plain transfer and an ERC-20 transfer in the native coin. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
name: evm_gas
